title: LF FEEDBACK: My game so far its called Golden Goose: Defenders (Three.js, Phaser)
author: Putrid-Buy-3237
selftext:
I made this using Cursor and Cursor Grok 4.5, Three.js and Phaser, eleven labs api, Cursor Grok image generation, Grok coding. Took a while to make this, and the idea been started over 1.5 year ago. 

WOULD LOVE FEEDBACK, how to get animations work better? How to get more polished sprite sheets that are ai generated. (Should i build a sprite tool to handle it in cursor?). 

Alot is implemented in the game allready such as: 

\- Experience system, with rewards.

\- 12 Bosses, different abilities 24 Enemy types. (Sprite sheets 6-8 for each one).

\- 4 Campaigns. 12 waves in each one. (1 run takes 15-20 mins). 1.5 Hours to complete Torment 1 on all campaigns, and most likely 100+ Hours to complete all difficulties. 

\- Torment/Tier system 1-12 and one Mythic. (Loads of calculations made here)

\- Shop system.

\- Weather system for all waves. (random timing)

\- Itemization, Trinkets, Rings, Weapons.

\- 10 classes, different passive bonus system.

\- Bag system, Stash system.

\- Starting area with 5 NPC.

\- This is not even everything yet. 

much more to come.

comments.author: joeban1
comments.body:
Really dont get how a lot of you guys can spend time creating something like this, and not realise it has that typical ai slop look that people hate.

Dont get me wrong, im not one of the guys that comes in here hating, im building my own games with ai too. But its very obvious to me what looks like slop, and i actively work to remove it. 

This is as sloppy as it gets, are you actually not able to see it?

replies.author: Putrid-Buy-3237
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback this is the reason i want more feedback so i can improve it, its not final yet and still early. I think many using Ai is beginners to making games, feedback apreciated thanks.

replies.author: New-Part-6917
replies.body: You are moving too fast. You finish a feature half-baked and call it done and move on to the next. That is the issue. There is a big difference between blocking out all the systems and just considering the feature good enough. You are building yourself into a corner with all the unnecessary details that shouldn't be added until the prior foundations are solid.

replies.author: New-Part-6917
replies.body: I can see it was not intentional though. You clearly have creativity, take your time. Keep at it you will improve.

replies.author: Putrid-Buy-3237
replies.body: I do agree with you, thank you for sharing as well its great so i can improve - need to get more patient with the project, ive got fullblown adhd to be honest so i will revisit earlier processes and improve them.

comments.author: angrylittledev
comments.body: Change everything UI wise, the whole artwork, unless you can convince people to buy GPT made artwork this won't get you far. Even people who generally don't care about AI in their games will take one look at this and skip it.. If you have a good mechanic that you think it works keep it, everything else AI made toss it out, get a voice changer and redo all audio by yourself, the AI audio sounds bad. Everything looks janky and like cutout cardboard pieces.

replies.author: Putrid-Buy-3237
replies.body: Thank you for your feedback, definetly will take your ideas into consideration, allready working on sound changes.

comments.author: Kingnorik

I don't know how you're generating sprite sheets but one of the tools is a spite sheet normalizer that normalizes the sprite between two different sheets.

replies.author: Putrid-Buy-3237
replies.body: Thanks this is really helpful i will check it out.

comments.author: darktaco
comments.body:
Have to agree with what the others have said here. It looks like a very, very early concept. It's neat you have 10 classes, bonus loot systems, bags, stashes, shops, difficulty tiers, bosses, a GLOBAL LEADERBOARD, etc, etc, etc, but the game itself? The whole picture? Looks like an internal prototype. The "Starting Area" isn't finished, right? A background image with...the normal game lanes on top? All translucent enough to be annoying? 

Have you thought that maybe you are moving too fast? Your trailer has sound bugs in it that happen sometimes with AI generated audio (45s into the trailer is a good example). It's like you never even watched your own trailer? You spent 30 seconds of all our time selling junk items to a vendor in your game to illustrate what? That it was possible? 

I'm not even mad about the AI stuff - working on my own heavily AI-influenced project like others here - but the lack of any attention to making it look right? Sound right? Attention to what you are going to publicly show off? There just isn't any care taken anywhere.

My advice would be to take a break from the development grind, spend some time doing something else that you enjoy, and then come back and pick it up like a new player. Come at it from an adversarial point of view - look at what you could complain about. Sure, the animations are sketchy, that's one part. But there are \*a lot\* of things to fix. Start at the title screen, move through the starting area, and level them all up one by one to reach a new "standard" that you hold throughout the rest of development.

Again thanks alot apreciate your inputs
